Your little woodland recipe

Use this scene as a layout sketch. The jar is shown at approximately 20 × 28 cm; check the mature size of your plants before choosing them.

  1. Add a shallow layer of small pebbles.
  2. Add suitable terrarium soil, with a gentle rise at the back.
  3. Arrange small ferns at the back and sides.
  4. Tuck moss around the planting, leaving a clearing for the deer.
  5. Add your ceramic friend and a handwritten birthday note.

The sliders change the visual arrangement. Plant count and dimensions are planning estimates.
